CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. File No. 9571/39
S. 1, Special Branch Mitchell
REPORT
Date December 11, 1939.

Subject Jessfield Road severed head crime.

Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

Reference the attached report on the Jessfield
Road severed head crime, further discreet enquiries
reveal that the deceased Siau Wang (小汪), alias
Wang Ts Doong (王士潼), is also known as Wang
Siau Keu Ts (王小狗子). He was a follower of
Zi Vee Kong (徐維江), a loafer in the Jessfield
area. In June, 1939, he joined the Wang Ching Wei
group known as the Special Service Corps of the
Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National
Salvation Army and was detailed to work in the section
then situated at No. 6 Zeu Ching Li, inside Lane 95,
Edinburgh Road, O.O.L. This section later removed
to 1081 Jessfield Road but was dissolved on October
22, 1939, following a shooting affray between the
members and the Municipal Police. After leaving the
corps, Siau Wang and a number of his fellow members
organized themselves into a gang of armed robbers
with Wang Siao Er Ts (王小二子), an ex-section
commander of the Special Service Corps of the Chung
Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National Salvation
Army as leader. Although members of this gang have
severed connections with the Special Service Corps
of the Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and
National Salvation Army, they nevertheless continue
to maintain intimate personal relations with the
majority of the members of the corps and for this
reason, it is said, they are not interfered with in

（左侧手写批注：DC Crawford / For information）

（印章：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER / 12 DEC. 1939 / (CR)）

主题：极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）斩首案。

由警佐麦克阿迪（MacAdie）制作，由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No: □□□□
REC.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date December 6; 1939.
Subject Jessfield Road Severed head crime - victim stated to be informer
of Gordon Road Station.
Made by D.S.I. Mac Adie Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

（左侧手写批注：）
Confidential report
DD/E
D.C. 'B'
E.

Information has been received to the effect
that Siau Wang (小王), alias Wang Ts Doong
(王子潼), whose severed head was found on
Jessfield road at 11.20 p.m. December 1st and whose
headless corpse was discovered on a piece of vacant
ground nearby, was executed by members of the Wang
Ching Wei group of which he is an ex-member for
giving information to Gordon Road detectives leading
to the arrest of a number of armed robbers. The
arrested men in this case were connected with the
Wang Ching Wei armed groups and were concerned in
an armed robbery on Ferry Road involving $40,000.00.

It is reported that Wang Siao Er is (王少子),
ex-Commander of the now defunct Special Service
Section of the Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern
and National Salvation Army at 1081 Jessfield Road
was responsible for the murder and beheading of Siau
Wang, assisted by his former subordinates who are
reported to be in hiding somewhere in Loo Sih Zah
(盧師宅) off Brenan Road, U.O.L.. This group
is now operating as a gang of armed robbers.

C.D.S. Loh Kung Dien (陸根弟) attached to
Gordon Road Station is also stated to have been
threatened for his part in effecting the arrest of
the robbers in question. He is on special leave at
present but whether this is as a result of the
threats or otherwise is not known.

（左侧手写批注：）
D.C. Greighe

报告
日期：1939年12月6日。
主题：极司菲尔路斩首案——受害者据称为戈登路分局线人。
由警佐麦克阿迪（Mac Adie）制作，由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈

（左侧手写批注：）
机密报告
DD/E
D.C. 'B'
E.

收到消息称，小王（Siau Wang），又名王子潼（Wang Ts Doong），其头颅于12月1日晚上11点20分在极司菲尔路被发现，无头尸体则在附近的一块空地上被发现，他是被汪精卫集团成员处决的，因为他曾是该集团成员，并向戈登路探员提供情报，导致多名武装抢劫犯被捕。此案的被捕者与汪精卫武装团体有关，并参与了一起涉及40,000.00美元的渡船路（Ferry Road）武装抢劫案。

据报道，前“中国国民党反共救国军特别服务队”极司菲尔路1081号分队长（该分队现已解散）王少子（Wang Siao Er is）负责杀害并斩首小汪，协助他的是其前下属，据报这些人正躲藏在越界筑路区（U.O.L.）勃伦南路（Brenan Road）旁的卢师宅（Loo Sih Zah）某处。该团伙目前作为一伙武装抢劫犯活动。

据称，隶属于戈登路分局的华捕陆根弟（Loh Kung Dien）也因参与逮捕上述抢劫犯而受到威胁。他目前正在休特别假，但这是否是因为受到威胁所致，尚不清楚。

（左侧手写批注：）
D.C. Greighe
信息和谣言
有待证实。
为什么？

R. W. Mac Adie.
警佐

1.

MURDER. O.C.L. P S 03

At 11.25 p.m. 1-12-39, a telephone message was
received from C.P.C.2781 No.6 Box, to the effect that a
human head had been thrown on to the roadway from a passing
car at Brenan Place. The undersigned, S.I. Munnings and
C.D.S.163 immediately proceeded to the scene and on arrival
the severed head of a male Chinese age about 30, was seen
lying in the middle of the roadway with two holes presum-
ably bullet wounds through his skull. Enquiries made at
the scene ascertained that the head had been thrown from a
closed motor car Lic.No. unknown which had come in an
easterly direction along Jessfield Road to Brenan Place
about 11.20 p.m. Although lengthy enquiries were conducted
no further information which would lead to the identifica-
tion of the car concerned, was obtained at that time.
Information was then received from a plain clothes member
of the S.C.G.P.Bureau that the body was lying on a piece
of waste ground off Jessfield Road. The above mentioned
officers accompanied by several members of the S.C.G.P.B.
accordingly proceeded to Lane 1384 Jessfield Road about
400 yards from Brenan Place, but as the spot where the
body was left was about 100 yards off the Municipal Road,
it was not deemed advisable to proceed to the scene.
Subsequently Mr. Samson, A.C.P. and Inspector Smith
arrived and the two members of the S.C.G.P.B. guarding the
entrance to the alleyway were asked permission to view the

                   12月   2,      39.
1.

谋杀。越界筑路区（O.C.L.） P S 03

1939年12月1日晚上11点25分，接到来自中央电话交换台2781号第6箱的电话留言，称有人从一辆过路汽车上将一个人头扔到了勃伦巷（Brenan Place）的马路上。下文签署人、巡佐曼宁斯（Munnings）和华捕163号立即前往现场，到达后发现一个约30岁的中国男性头颅躺在马路中央，头骨上有两个洞，推测为枪伤。在现场进行的查询查明，该头颅是从一辆车牌号不明的封闭机动车上扔下的，该车于晚上11点20分左右沿极司菲尔路向东行驶至勃伦巷。尽管进行了长时间的查询，但当时并未获得能识别涉事车辆的进一步信息。随后从便衣警察部门（S.C.G.P.Bureau）的一名便衣成员处获悉，尸体躺在极司菲尔路外的一块荒地上。上述警官在几名便衣警察部门成员的陪同下，随即前往距勃伦巷约400码的极司菲尔路1384弄，但由于尸体被丢弃的地点距离市政道路约100码，认为不宜进入现场。随后，助理总监萨姆森（Samson）先生和史密斯（Smith）督察到达，获准查看

pages.en:
Misc.No. 697/39.
1/sheet 2.

body. Then the desired permission was granted, it was
ascertained that the decapitated remains of the deceased
was lying on a piece of waste ground about 100 yards away
from the entrance to the alleyway. As it was suspected
that he had met his death through shooting, a search was
made which resulted in three empty mauser cartridge cases
being found near the body, also one spent bullet which had
evidently passed through the head of deceased. These
exhibits will be forwarded to the Arms Identification
Section on the morning of 2-12-39.

Permission was then asked from the members of the
S.C.G.P.B. to finger print and photograph the body, but
they stated it would be better to wait until the morning
of 2-12-39 and the necessary arrangements could be made
then. The undersigned had previously asked for the
services of the Finger Print Bureau in order that
photographs of the head be taken, but discovered that on
returning to Brenan Place after examining the body, the
head had been taken away by members of the S.C.G.P.B.
However, it is not thought likely that there will be any
difficulty in getting permission to photograph the head
when the body is done on 2-12-39.

When the undersigned and C.D.S.165 returned to the
station, C.P.C.s 2348,2659 and 2793 No.23 Traffic Post
reported to the Charge Room, that at 11.05p.m. 1-12-39,
they noticed a number of people gazing at a notice posted
pages.zh:

1/第2页。

尸体。在获得所需许可后，查明死者的无头遗体躺在距巷口约100码的一块荒地上。由于怀疑他是因枪击身亡，遂进行搜索，结果在尸体附近发现了三个空的毛瑟子弹壳，以及一颗显然穿过死者头部的已发射子弹。这些物证将于1939年12月2日上午送交武器鉴定科。

随后向便衣警察部门成员请求对尸体进行指纹采集和拍照，但他们表示最好等到1939年12月2日上午，届时可以做出必要安排。下文签署人此前曾要求指纹局提供服务以便拍摄头颅照片，但发现在检查尸体后返回勃伦巷时，头颅已被便衣警察部门成员带走。然而，预计在1939年12月2日处理尸体时，获取拍摄头颅照片的许可不会有任何困难。

当下文签署人和华捕165号返回警局时，中央电话交换台2348、2659和2793号第23交通岗向值班室报告，1939年12月1日晚上11点05分，他们注意到许多人正凝视着张贴在

pages.en:
Misc.No.697/39.
1/sheet 3.

on an electric standard outside a gambling den on the
west side of Brenan Place about 30 yards away from the
spot where the head was thrown. The notice was to this
effect:-
"At 11p.m. 1-12-39, we execute one named Wong Ta
Doong (王子潼) alias Wong Fung Tsang (王鳳章) alias
Shau □□□ (小王) age 34, native of Chingkiang attached
to Singa Police Station, whom we had arrested for
admitting that he had done wrong regarding our activities
in the Western Area. We accordingly post this notice and
warn people not to do this sort of thing again".
This notice was taken away by the members of the S.C.
C.P.B. before the undersigned was aware of its existence.
The C.P.C.s at the time, did not take it away being under
the impression that the notice had been posted by the
S.C.C.P.B.
Detectives on night duty at Singa Station were
communicated with, but they did not know of any informer
of that name used by detectives from that station. Further
enquiries will be made on 2-12-39, as it is possible that
the man mentioned may be known to the other Chinese
detectives attached to Singa Station.
While detectives were coming away from the scene of
the murder, another witness named Lee Woo Sang (李和商),
hawker, was located. This man stated that about 11.30p.m.

勃伦巷西侧一家赌窟外电线杆上的告示，该地点距头颅被丢弃处约30码。告示内容如下：
“1939年12月1日晚上11点，我们处决了一名名叫王子潼（Wong Ta Doong），又名王凤章（Wong Fung Tsang），又名小王（Shau □□□），34岁，镇江人，隶属于新闸警察局的人，他承认在我们西区活动方面犯了错误。因此我们张贴此告示，警告人们不要再做此类事情”。
在下文签署人知晓该告示存在之前，它已被便衣警察部门（S.C. C.P.B.）成员拿走。当时的中央电话交换台接线员并未将其拿走，因为他们误以为该告示是由便衣警察部门张贴的。
已与新闸警局夜班探员联系，但他们不知道该局探员使用过该姓名的线人。1939年12月2日将进行进一步调查，因为其他隶属于新闸警局的华籍探员可能认识此人。
当探员们离开谋杀现场时，找到了另一名目击者，小贩李和商（Lee Woo Sang）。此人陈述，约晚上11点30分

pages.en:
1/sheet 4.

1-12-39, he noticed a closed car (he did not notice the
Lic.No. however), proceeding West to East on Jessfield
Road. The car stopped and an object was thrown out.
Lee on picking up this object discovered that it was a
grey felt hat, covered in blood and a rent through the
crown. This witness was closely questioned about the
motor car in question and stated that he was under the
impression it was a Johnson Hire car. Enquiries were
made at Johnson Hire Garages, but they stated that none
of their vehicles were on Jessfield Road during the
stated times.

Description of murdered man:-
age about 30 years, medium build, dressed in
black gabardine overcoat, blue silk trousers
and brown cloth slippers, appearance of loafer
type.

Enquiries proceeding.

Sen. Det.
D.D.C.I.B. Div.

Ja Kennedy.
D.S.I.

1939年12月1日，他注意到一辆封闭汽车（但他未注意车牌号）在极司菲尔路上由西向东行驶。汽车停下，有人扔出一个物体。李捡起该物体，发现是一顶灰色毡帽，上面沾满血迹，帽顶有一道裂口。就该机动车对该证人进行了详细询问，他表示印象中那是一辆约翰逊租车行（Johnson Hire）的汽车。已向约翰逊租车行车库进行查询，但他们表示在规定时间段内，他们的车辆均未在极司菲尔路上。

死者描述：
年龄约30岁，中等身材，身穿黑色华达呢大衣，蓝色丝绸裤子和棕色布拖鞋，外貌呈无业游民类型。

调查进行中。

高级侦探
刑事调查部副主任

Ja Kennedy.
